name: Trip Concierge
description: Turns your flight, hotel and car confirmations into a trip plan, then walks you through it: check-in reminders, weather and packing, when to leave for the airport, the hotel address on arrival.

examples: add hotel Marriott Times Square dec 3-6

settings.label: Hours at the airport
settings.help: How early to be at the airport before departure. Leave empty for 2 hours domestic, 3 international. Example: 2.5
